# Prince Raj

> Prince Raj is a full-stack developer and computer science undergraduate from India who builds production SaaS products, backend systems and AI infrastructure, mostly in TypeScript with NestJS, Next.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL and Supabase.

He is the creator of GST Reco Pro (gstrecopro.in), a privacy-first SaaS that converts Indian GST portal PDFs into Excel entirely in the browser, and wakacraft (wakacraft.tech), an open-source, self-hostable alternative to WakaTime. He works professionally as a backend engineer on multi-tenant business platforms, takes freelance projects, writes engineering blogs on Medium, and has one published patent.

## Pages
- [Home](https://theprinceraj.in/): Portfolio with featured projects, testimonials and contact details
- [Blogs](https://theprinceraj.in/blogs): Index of his engineering blog posts
- [Full profile](https://theprinceraj.in/llms.full.txt): Long version of this file with project details, professional work and testimonials

## Products
- [GST Reco Pro](https://gstrecopro.in): Zero-data-risk PDF-to-Excel converter and reconciliation tool for Indian tax professionals.
- [wakacraft](https://wakacraft.tech): Open-source, self-hostable WakaTime alternative that works with every WakaTime editor plugin.
- [Project Sentinel](https://sentinel.theprinceraj.in): AI governance proxy that inspects every application-to-LLM request and response.
- [CoverGenius AI](https://cv.theprinceraj.in): AI cover letter generator that tailors a letter to a resume PDF and a job description.

## Projects
- [Qoody](https://prince.is-a.dev/qoody/): Free Android expense tracker that logs UPI, card and bank payments from notifications and SMS.
- [Smart Paste](https://github.com/theprinceraj/paste-smart): Windows tray app that asks an AI model which copied item fits the active window, then pastes it.
- [AI Notes Generator](https://github.com/theprinceraj/ai-notes-generator): Turns a recorded YouTube class into handwritten-style study notes as PDFs in Hindi, English and Hinglish.
- Marketing video pipeline: Prompt-driven pipeline that produces product launch videos from a website or codebase at no cost.
- The Internet Mind: A single shared AI whose knowledge is written and contested by its users (in development).
- EchoMate: AI voice-calling backend that runs outbound lead campaigns for organisations.
- Local Social: Modular backend for a location-aware social media app.
- [Decentralised uptime monitor](https://github.com/theprinceraj/uptime-monitor): Website uptime monitor where independent validators sign their checks with Solana keypairs.
- [Markshify](https://github.com/theprinceraj/Markshify): OCR scanner that turns marksheets into structured CSV for college exam cells.

## Professional work
- Multi-tenant visitor management platform (backend): Backend for registering, checking in and checking out visitors across many organisations and sites.
- Business operations platform with AI features (backend): Product and catalogue operations backend for an enterprise client.
- Organisation management platform (backend): Backend for managing entities, subsidiaries, departments, positions, openings and people.
- Trade-show lead capture app: Installable, mobile-first PWA that booth staff use to turn visitors into follow-up leads.

## Writing
- [How I Discovered and Helped Fix a Security Flaw in a Government Portal?](https://medium.com/@theprinceraj/discovering-a-security-flaw-in-a-government-portal-used-by-3-lakh-students-ad3bf67a0513): While using a government portal serving over 3 lakh students and beneficiaries, I discovered a Broken Access Control vulnerability that could expose sensitive information to unauthorized users. This article documents the complete journey—from discovery and validation to responsible disclosure with CERT-In and eventual remediation.
- [How Access Token and Refresh Token Work in Authentication Flows in Modern Backend Systems?](https://medium.com/@theprinceraj/how-access-token-and-refresh-token-work-in-authentication-flows-in-modern-backend-systems-1ef6e498e217): Almost any application you use today, uses access tokens and refresh tokens to handle its authentication flows. Have you ever wondered how you stay logged into your favorite apps for days without re-entering your password? The secret lies in two special tokens working behind the scenes: access tokens and refresh tokens.
- [NestJS Payments Setup Made Simple: Implementing Razorpay in Your Backend API](https://medium.com/@theprinceraj/nestjs-payments-setup-made-simple-implementing-razorpay-in-your-backend-api-49f68b41c462): A practical, step-by-step guide to integrating Razorpay with a NestJS backend. This article explains some payment concepts you need to know (orders, payments, and security), shows how to configure Razorpay credentials, implements server-side payment creation and verification. Ideal for backend developers looking to add payment flows to their APIs without getting lost in the docs.
- [How Most Social Media Check Your Username in Milliseconds: A Gentle Guide to Bloom Filters](https://medium.com/@theprinceraj/how-most-social-media-check-your-username-in-milliseconds-a-gentle-guide-to-bloom-filters-94d89ca40973): On popular social media platforms like Instagram, checking whether a username is available has to happen almost instantly, even when the system is handling millions or billions of accounts. Instead of searching linearly, Bloom Filters are used to quickly rule out usernames that definitely do not exist and narrow the search. This makes availability checks much faster and more efficient. Let's explore how this probabilistic data structure works!
